editorial.blurb: Smyth delivers meticulous fine-dining craftsmanship with impeccable service in a deliberately minimalist setting, where every detail—from warm towels to constant water refills—reflects surgical precision.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead to alert them of any texture-related food preferences or dietary concerns; the staff is remarkably accommodating and willing to substitute dishes on the spot to ensure a comfortable experience.
